name: Daedelus
hook: A Los Angeles electronic musician whose chord-organ tune became the loop of Madvillain's 'Accordion'.

blurb.age7: A musician from Los Angeles. A tune he played on an old organ became a famous MF DOOM song.
blurb.age13: Alfred Darlington, who records as Daedelus, came up with a melody in a piano class at the University of Southern California in the late 1990s. In 2002 he recorded it on a Magnus electric chord organ, a cheap home instrument, for a track called 'Experience' on his first album, Invention. Madlib sampled it for Madvillain's 'Accordion' in 2004. That's why the famous 'accordion' sound isn't an accordion.
blurb.adult: Daedelus is a sample hub (Q21) from inside the same Los Angeles beat scene Madlib worked in, which makes this a sample between contemporaries rather than a rediscovery of an old record. The instrument detail is kept because it corrects a widely repeated assumption carried in the song's own title.
